hooks.text: 开放构筑允许随时购买任意法术或升级，每局自由试验组合
hooks.excerpt: Rift Wizard uses an open build system, and allows the player to buy any spell or spell upgrade at any time. This gives the player massive flexibility, allowing them to test out new ideas each run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 传送门让玩家选择关卡、起点与资源分配，自主决定所受挑战
hooks.excerpt: Rift Wizard's unique portal system means the player always has agency over what challenges they face. You choose which levels to visit, where to start, and how to spend your resources.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 收集宇宙遗迹材料合成魔法装备，稀有材料会改变成品效果
hooks.excerpt: New to Rift Wizard 3 is a deep and strategic crafting system. You will find a vast assortment of crafting components strewn across the ruins of the universe, which can be combined to form powerful magical artifacts giving passive buffs to the wizard. The player must make difficult choices about how to allocate their limited and diverse magical resources, with rare crafting ingredients even having unique impacts on the crafted item.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
